glosses: to blab, to reveal (e.g. a secret, to let something slip)
to spill the beans, to let the cat out of the bag
To tell tales; to gossip without reserve or discretion.

examples.text: And yonder a vile physician blabbing / The case of his patient.

1998, "Helga Blabs It All", TV episode in season 3 of Hey Arnold!, animated television series created by Craig Bartlett
Helga Blabs It All.

glosses: One who blabs; a babbler; a telltale; a gossip or gossiper.

examples.text: "You'd better have shoved your grey snout in a hornets' nest, Badger, than suggest that I am the blab," said Nikabrik.
Audie never liked him because he was further in with old Craig than he was, bragging and blowing about his work and the things he could do, while Audie sat quiet as a mouse listening to his blab.

glosses: Dar a conocer o divulgar algo hasta entonces mantenido en secreto u oculto.

examples.text: va propalando el secreto al oído de sus tías, amigos, parientes, advirtiendo siempre que no se lo cuenten a nadie.

glosses: Quitar o impedir el sueño, no dejar dormir.

examples.text: Éstos son los grandes enigmas que desvelan a los científicos.

glosses: Mostrar o contar algo que debiera estar oculto.

examples.text: Al salir de la Casa de las Tablillas aquella tarde, se puso a buscarla decidido a desvelar el misterio de su desaparición lo más pronto posible.

glosses: Contar algo que debía permanecer en secreto.

examples.text: Vicepresidente de EEUU se “fue de la lengua” en pleno micrófono.

glosses: (di aria o vento), soffiare da uno spiraglio
